Lobster Heaven! Hands down the best seafood in town!
Apr 2026 • Family
If you are a seafood lover, you cannot miss this place! We came here specifically for the lobster, and it exceeded every expectation. We had the grilled garlic butter lobster, and the meat was incredibly sweet, firm, and pulled right off the shell—a clear sign of freshness.

The seasoning was perfect—not too overpowering, allowing the natural flavor of the lobster to shine. We also tried the salt and pepper lobster claws which were addictive. The staff were attentive and even helped us crack the shells. It’s a bit of a splurge, but worth every single penny. I’ll be dreaming about this meal for a long time!
